UP Gautam Buddh Nagar ECCE Educator Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : UP Rojgar Sangam (Sewayojan) Portal has released the notification for the post of ECCE Educator in the Department of Basic Education Uttar Pradesh. Candidates must check the complete details for UP Gautam Buddh Nagar ECCE Educator Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
